instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level full shot from behind. In a training dojo with a textured brown wall, the standing woman in the black gi (R1) is positioned with her back to the camera, holding the leg of the girl in the pink gi (R2). The girl in the pink gi (R2) is inverted, balancing on her shoulders on the black mat with her legs extended upward. The standing woman in the black gi (R1) controls the position from above. Soft indoor lighting highlights the grapplers against the neutral background.
elements: R1 holds R2's leg while R2 is inverted
R1 controls the grappling position from above rather than being controlled by R2
R2 balances upside down on her shoulders on the mat while R1 stands
R1 is the standing grappler and R2 is the inverted grappler
